correctness.rationale: Starting with a general 2x2 map N(e1)=a e1+b e2, N(e2)=c e1+d e2, expansion of the Nijenhuis identity on four ordered basis pairs of EACH actual multiplication table reduces in either case to c^2=0,bc=0,b(a-d)=0. Over any field c=0. Product-preserving invertible maps are exactly diag(1,s), s != 0; conjugation scales b, leaving singleton D(a,d) and one orbit J(a) per a. Count q^2 diagonal points and q(q-1) shear points; square-zero iff a=d=0 for shears plus zero diagonal; idempotence of shear requires a^2=a and 2a=1, impossible in every field including characteristic 2. Independent evaluator enumerated all endomorphism identities for q=2,3,5 for both algebras and obtained 2q^2-q (6,15,45) in each case. Finite enumeration corroborates, but unrestricted statement follows symbolic proof.
